decision: Promoted at floor 33. rows>=33 gains 4.2-4.9% prefill and 1.3-3.6% AR plus 1.7-2.9% MTP; rows 16/32 (captured verify groups) keep the unfused chain. The stateless row-count floor is an explicit proxy for prefill-vs-verify context and is tracked in docs/REFACTOR.md, because a session-scoped floor would have to participate in _DISPATCH_RESOLVE_CACHE / _PAIR_DISPATCH_RESOLVE_CACHE keys to be safe.
